item.title: Owner-Inspectability: The Limits of Independent Security Verification on Vendor-Locked Devices
item.description: Vendor-locked devices -- most prominently stock Android phones, which ship with a locked bootloader and no administrative rights -- are general-purpose computers whose owners cannot fully inspect, control, or verify the software they run.
